subject.title: [Feature]: Auto-discovery of agent configurations from external workspaces

question: Should OpenClaw support trusted external workspace agent-config discovery, or keep agent registration explicit through config/RPC/CLI workflows?
rationale: The request adds a new config key, filesystem scanning, trust roots, precedence rules, runtime registration, and session-routing semantics that current source and VISION.md do not settle.

options.title: Keep Explicit Registration
options.body: Continue using `agents.list`, `agents.create/update/delete`, `openclaw agents add`, `$include`, and operator tooling unless a smaller missing API is identified.

options.title: Design Trusted Discovery
options.body: Approve a bounded core discovery contract that specifies roots, config file names, merge precedence, validation, reload semantics, and security proof before implementation.

options.title: Narrow To Zero-Restart Management
options.body: Focus on making explicit agent registration hot-load safely before considering automatic glob-based discovery.

recommendation.title: Keep Explicit Registration
recommendation.body: Continue using `agents.list`, `agents.create/update/delete`, `openclaw agents add`, `$include`, and operator tooling unless a smaller missing API is identified.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest feature-history signal across agent listing, gateway agent management, and agent config boundaries.
